rows.title: Neon Drift — Free Online Drift Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: Arcade drift score-attack on three authored circuits. Hold the slide, skim the apex, and cash the combo before the grip comes back.

rows.title: Neon Drift Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Neon Drift is a two-lap arcade slide, not a sim. The useful skill is keeping the car sideways through authored sectors so the combo never resets. Session 60–90 sec runs.

rows.title: How to Play Neon Drift | Gamesweb
rows.description: Accelerate into the first corner, hold the slide, then countersteer so the angle stays alive through the apex. Accelerate into the first corner and hold a slide.

rows.title: Neon Drift Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: Keyboard or on-screen stick. Space is a handbrake, not a boost — it dumps grip so the next corner can enter drift. W / ↑: Accelerate · S / ↓: Brake · A D / ← →: Steer · Space: Handbrake · 1 2 3: Switch track · G: Toggle ghost · R: Restart

rows.title: Neon Drift Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: Enter Harbour Loop wide, then tighten on the inner curb. The near-miss multiplier (1.48×) is worth more than a safe middle line.

rows.title: Neon Drift Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Neon Drift tracks 10 trophies, from First Slide to Evening Line.

rows.title: Neon Drift Tracks | Gamesweb
rows.description: Neon Drift ships 3 authored circuits: Harbour Loop, Hairpin District, Ridge Sweep.

rows.title: Neon Drift Scoring | Gamesweb
rows.description: Score is a live drift bank, not a lap timer. Higher is better. Two laps close the circuit.

rows.title: Velocity Run — Free Online Parkour Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: Twelve authored rooftop courses across HVAC training, crane transit, and comms ascent. Coyote time, jump buffering, and a restart that never argues.

rows.title: Velocity Run Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Velocity Run is millisecond parkour on ivory/cobalt rooftops. The sport is routing — safe, fast, or expert — not surviving a clock that keeps running after a death. Session 30–90 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Velocity Run | Gamesweb
rows.description: Move, jump, and fast-fall to the beacon. First finishes usually land bronze or silver. Gold needs a line. Platinum is a clean ghost. Reach the beacon. Faster is better.

rows.title: Velocity Run Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: A/D or arrows move. Space or Up jumps with coyote time and jump buffering. Down fast-falls. R is the real verb. A D / ← →: Move · Space / ↑: Jump · S / ↓: Fast fall · 1 2 3: Switch course · G: Toggle ghost · R: Restart

rows.title: Velocity Run Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: Learn Gate A on the safe low ledges, then take the high fast pads. The expert skip at the mid gap is the platinum tell.

rows.title: Velocity Run Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Velocity Run tracks 10 trophies, from Beacon to Split Hunter.

rows.title: Velocity Run Courses | Gamesweb
rows.description: Velocity Run has 12 authored courses across training, transit, ascent.

rows.title: Velocity Run Scoring | Gamesweb
rows.description: Lower time is better. Medals are authored per course, not a global curve.

rows.title: Swarm Protocol — Free Online Survival Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: Compact arena survival with auto-fire, readable silhouettes, and upgrades that rewrite the sixth minute. The Core ends the run.

rows.title: Swarm Protocol Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Swarm Protocol is a six-minute arena. Skill lives in positioning, dash timing, and which three-of-many upgrades you stack — not in aiming. Session 6–8 min.

rows.title: How to Play Swarm Protocol | Gamesweb
rows.description: WASD to move, Shift to dash. Auto-fire handles the rest so you can read silhouettes and leave a contrast pocket around the player. Move. The weapon tracks the nearest hostiles.

rows.title: Swarm Protocol Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: Move and dash are the only in-run verbs. 1/2/3 pick an upgrade when a core levels you. R restarts after death. WASD / arrows: Move · Shift: Dash · 1 2 3: Pick upgrade · Esc: Pause · R: Restart after death

rows.title: Swarm Protocol Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: First two minutes are density, not damage. Take Magnetic Core or Protocol Tempo so cores and fire rate keep the pocket clear.

rows.title: Swarm Protocol Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Swarm Protocol tracks 10 trophies, from First Blood to Cascade.

rows.title: Sky Stack — Free Online Stacking Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: One-thumb climbing. Place the moving slab, keep the overlap, ride fever. A miss ends the climb.

rows.title: Sky Stack Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Sky Stack is a portrait climb. The only decision is when to place. Perfects keep width; misses are instant retries. Session 20–90 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Sky Stack | Gamesweb
rows.description: Watch the slab pass over the tower and place it. Perfects are full overlaps. Fever is a long perfect streak, not a separate mode. Tap, click, or press Space to place the moving slab.

rows.title: Sky Stack Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: One action: Space, click, or tap places the slab. R retries. That is the whole map. Space / click / tap: Place · R: Retry

rows.title: Sky Stack Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Sky Stack tracks 5 trophies, from Placed to Sixty Seven.

rows.title: Knockout Circuit — Free Online Obstacle Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: Eight modular obstacle maps across Factory, Skyworks, and Signal Core. Move, jump, dash. Ghosts are recorded rivals, not live players.

rows.title: Knockout Circuit Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Knockout Circuit is an obstacle race with eight authored maps. The verb set is move, jump, dash — and taking the expert shortcut when the ghost already committed. Session 45–120 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Knockout Circuit | Gamesweb
rows.description: Sprint to the finish banner. Dash (Shift) is a burst, not i-frames. A hazard hit costs time; Untouched is finishing without one. Reach the banner. Faster is better.

rows.title: Knockout Circuit Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: Same move/jump grammar as Velocity, plus Shift dash. The dash is why the two games still play differently on similar keys. A D / ← →: Move · Space / ↑: Jump · Shift: Dash · 1 2 3: Switch first maps · R: Retry

rows.title: Knockout Circuit Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: Starter Gates is a read of hammer / mover / inflate. Wait the inflate, then dash the landing — do not jump into a rising gate.

rows.title: Knockout Circuit Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Knockout Circuit tracks 4 trophies, from Through to Greedy.

rows.title: Pocket Striker — Free Online Physics Sports Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: Eighteen authored tables across Workshop, Garden, and Arcade Lab. Pull back to aim, release to strike. Fewer strokes win.

rows.title: Pocket Striker Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Pocket Striker is a short physics table. You do not time a gate or hold a drift — you pick a vector and live with the cushions. Session 30–90 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Pocket Striker | Gamesweb
rows.description: Pull back, release, watch the bank. Retry is instant because the interesting decision is the next stroke, not a long life bar. Drag back from the striker to aim. Release to shoot.

rows.title: Pocket Striker Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: Pointer only for the shot: drag to aim and set power, release to strike. R retries the table. Keyboard is not a movement map. Drag / pointer: Aim and power · Release: Strike · R: Retry

rows.title: Pocket Striker Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: Bench Bank is a two-stroke par. The first shot should set a cushion; chasing a hero ace here is how you go three over.

rows.title: Pocket Striker Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Pocket Striker tracks 4 trophies, from Drop to Table Manners.

rows.title: Territory Rush — Free Online Territory Game | Gamesweb
rows.description: A 90-second geometric arena. Leave a trail, close the loop, claim the fill. Bots are seeded opponents with tells — never fake humans.

rows.title: Territory Rush Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Territory Rush is a paint-the-floor arena. The useful screenshot is a closed loop turning into owned color — not a toy city grid. Session ~90 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Territory Rush | Gamesweb
rows.description: Leave your color, draw a loop, come home. Small safe bites early. Larger claims when bots are committed to their own trails. Move. Your trail is a claim in progress.

rows.title: Territory Rush Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: WASD or stick moves the claimant. There is no jump, dash, or aim. R retries the 90-second arena. WASD / stick: Move · R: Retry

rows.title: Territory Rush Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: First claims should be shallow U-turns along your own border. Long diagonals across mid are how bots cut you.

rows.title: Territory Rush Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Territory Rush tracks 3 trophies, from Stake to Majority.

rows.title: Crowd Control — Free Online Crowd Runner | Gamesweb
rows.description: A skill runner with a living count. Steer the pack through +N, ×N, and TAX gates, then cash a finish multiplier.

rows.title: Crowd Control Guide | Gamesweb
rows.description: Crowd Control is a one-thumb runner whose score is the pack. The decision is which saturated gate you enter, not a lane of coins. Session 45–75 sec.

rows.title: How to Play Crowd Control | Gamesweb
rows.description: Steer into the gate you can afford. A ×4 on ten bodies beats a +30 on three. A TAX gate you cannot pay empties the parade. The pack runs forward. You steer.

rows.title: Crowd Control Controls | Gamesweb
rows.description: A/D or drag steers. Shift dashes. There is no jump. R retries the 45–75s rush. A D / drag: Steer · Shift: Dash · R: Retry

rows.title: Crowd Control Strategy | Gamesweb
rows.description: Read the sign, not the road. Huge +N / ×N / TAX art is the composition — if you need the HUD, you are already late.

rows.title: Crowd Control Achievements | Gamesweb
rows.description: Crowd Control tracks 4 trophies, from Through the gate to Parade.
